recommendation: Architect agent systems with resource isolation and contention mitigation
aws_service: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / Amazon Bedrock / Amazon CloudWatch
guidance: Shared resource pools let one noisy agent starve the rest. Priority tiers with dedicated resource allocations and contention detection keep user-facing agents responsive even when background workloads spike.
how_to_check: • You have separate runtime infrastructure for different agent priority tiers so high-priority agents have dedicated resources. • You track token consumption for each agent and enforce per-agent access to shared model capacity. • You detect contention early through composite signals and activate automated mitigation before failures occur. For more information, see the AGENTREL08-BP03 documentation.
